This line chart displays three policy index series over time, using a dual-axis layout. The horizontal axis represents years from 2016 to 2024. The left vertical axis, labeled “Index,” ranges from 0 to 1,000 and is used for “Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt” (black line) and “Finanzpolitik” (blue line). The right vertical axis, also labeled “Index,” ranges from 0 to 9,000 and is used for “Handelspolitik” (purple line). The black line starts near 50 in 2016, rises to a peak of approximately 500 around 2020, then declines to about 100 by 2022 before sharply increasing to around 650 by 2024. The blue line begins near 50 in 2016, fluctuates between approximately 50 and 200 until 2020, then drops to about 100 before rising to around 250 by 2024. The purple line remains near 0 until 2020, then rises to approximately 1,000 by 2022, and subsequently increases to about 8,000 by 2024.
